findings.evidence: run_arm derives arm_out in the same local declaration that assigns arm_root; set -u expands arm_root first and exits.
findings.reproduction: bash -c 'set -u; root=/tmp/x; f(){ local arm=$1 arm_root=$2 arm_out=$arm_root/$arm rc tag; }; f off "$root"'
findings.acceptance_test: Execute the actual factored arm-path function under set -u for OFF and ON.

findings.evidence: The frozen CLI parser rejects -n 0 before loading a model.
findings.acceptance_test: Use a supported no-generation CLI mode and execute its exact argument parse against a deliberately missing model.

findings.evidence: Exclusive logit publication failure is nonfatal to sync and the scorer did not require the exact success diagnostic or reject the failure diagnostic.
findings.reproduction: Precreate identical finite final logit paths in both fresh arm directories.
findings.acceptance_test: The driver and scorer require one exact successful publication and zero failures; a prepositioned final path fails.

findings.evidence: Preflight asserted the model digest but checked only path type and size.
findings.reproduction: Substitute a same-sized regular model artifact.
findings.acceptance_test: Hash the complete runtime model before launch and pin its device/inode/size identity across both arms.

findings.evidence: The production frozen schedule selects 2048 entries, while the scorer and its positive fixture accepted count one.
findings.reproduction: Run the existing count-one validate_selected fixture.
findings.acceptance_test: Require exactly 2048 entries per row and reject reduced, zero, excessive, and malformed padding counts.

findings.evidence: Hashing, semantic validation, and terminal inventory reopened artifact pathnames independently and terminal verification did not reject added paths.
findings.reproduction: Rewrite or replace a same-sized artifact between hash and semantic passes; add an artifact after receipt creation.
findings.acceptance_test: Hash and semantically validate through one descriptor with pre/post identity/timestamp checks, bind that digest to exact terminal inventory, and mutation-test rewrite/replacement/addition.
